title: BIR Form No. 1700 — Annual Income Tax Return for Individuals Earning Purely Compensation Income

choice_rows.label: Item 16 — If married, spouse has income?
Item 24 — Spouse claiming foreign tax credits?

validation.how: Messages only in a 'Needs review' block after Part III totals (first 20); labels turn red; Queue for submission is disabled.

lists.label: Part VI — Schedule 1: compensation and tax withheld
lists.rows_in_ui: dynamic (rows 1–4, then one blank row, up to 12)

findings.now: The Item 10 email goes into the submitted XML and onto the printed sheet in capitals.
findings.why: The XML field map calls to_uppercase on the email, a test locks that in, and the email must never be upper-cased.

options.name: Keep typed casing in the field map
options.detail: Drop the to_uppercase on txtPg1I10Email and change the test to expect the typed value.

options.name: Caps on the sheet only
options.detail: Keep the stored value as typed and let the print layer handle any capitals; the print map inherits the email from to_bir_field_map.

options.name: Exempt the email from the print join
options.detail: Remove the Item 10 text join in html-frozen/1700-2018/writer-cells.json (line 79) so the sheet prints the email as typed.

findings.now: The header reads January 2018 (ENCS) and Print preview opens the 1700-2018 sheet.
findings.why: The layout id and rule package are named 1700-v2013 and rules/forms/1700-v2013 describes the June 2013 HTA, so the identifiers and the content disagree.

options.name: Rename to the 2018 identifier
options.detail: If January 2018 is the filed revision, rename FORM_1700_FORM_ID and the layout id to a 2018 id.

options.name: Regenerate from the June 2013 HTA
options.detail: If June 2013 is the filed revision, regenerate the layout from BIR-Form1700.hta and replace the alert texts.

options.name: Mark the rule package superseded
options.detail: Keep January 2018 and record in rules/forms/1700-v2013 that the 2018 HTA is the source, so the two stop disagreeing.

findings.now: The year box stays editable after the draft is created, and changing it then pressing Save draft writes the draft under the new year.
findings.why: upsert_from_draft finds a draft by taxable_year and UPDATEs any existing Draft for that year with this page's data (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:154-175), so another year's draft can be overwritten.

options.name: Read-only year
options.detail: Show the year as fixed text once the draft exists, like Item 3 ATC, and open another year from the library instead.

options.name: Guard the save
options.detail: Refuse Save draft when the year differs from the stored year and point the user to the existing draft for that year.

options.name: Confirm before overwrite
options.detail: Ask before saving when a Draft already exists for the new year.

findings.now: The button is disabled and the reason appears only in a 'Needs review' block after the Part III totals at the bottom of the page.
findings.why: Labels turn red but no message sits beside any field, so the user must scroll past every section to learn what blocks filing.

options.name: Inline messages
options.detail: Render each message under its field, using the error keys the page already tracks, and keep the red label.

options.name: Summary beside Queue
options.detail: Show the Needs review list in the toolbar next to Queue for submission, with a jump link per item.

options.name: Jump to first error
options.detail: Add a button that scrolls to the first red field and shows its message.

findings.now: Name, address and line of business are sent in capitals even when they were only loaded from the profile.
findings.why: The bir-caps-display-only decision says profile-loaded fields get no blur and keep their mixed case in the upload.

options.name: Uppercase only typed values
options.detail: Mirror the official blur behaviour: capitalise values the filer typed and keep profile values as stored.

options.name: Caps in the renderer
options.detail: Keep stored casing in to_bir_field_map and let the print layer uppercase on the sheet.

options.name: Check a real upload first
options.detail: Compare one profile-only upload against the official output before changing the map.

findings.field: Part VI — Schedule 1: compensation and tax withheld
findings.now: The editor shows at most 12 employer rows and has no add control; a new row appears only after the last blank one is filled.
findings.why: EDITOR_EMPLOYER_ROWS (12) is below FORM_1700_MAX_EMPLOYERS (100), so employers 13 and up are hidden but still count in the Item 4 OTHERS subtotal.

options.name: Show every stored row
options.detail: Render all rows the draft holds, with an explicit Add employer button up to 100.

options.name: Refuse more than 12
options.detail: Block loading or saving a draft with more than 12 employers and say why.

options.name: Official popup list
options.detail: Mirror the official (add more...) popup as its own list with a visible count.

findings.now: A bad Item 4 check digit shows 'You have entered an incorrect TIN' with no item suffix, and the spouse Item 20 check shows a wording the official form does not use.
findings.why: The official TIN check messages end with the item number (BIR-Form1700v2018.hta:2486) and no official alert says 'Item no. 20' (desktop-only text).

options.name: Official Item 4 wording
options.detail: Show 'Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 4.' for a bad check digit, the text the official Item 4 checks use.

options.name: Add the item suffix
options.detail: Show 'You have entered an incorrect TIN on Item 4.' following the official pattern.

options.name: Drop the Item 20 text
options.detail: Remove the non-official Item 20 message or replace it with official Item 20 handling if one exists.

findings.now: Nothing visible changes, but the 1700 print commit also puts an 80-line test in the shared bir-print module, and commit f638078f changes form_1702ex.rs.
findings.why: Outside the form's own files only one-line registrations are allowed.

options.name: Move the test
options.detail: Move the filled-document test into the form_1700 test module and keep only the registration in frozen_html.rs.

options.name: Keep only the registration
options.detail: Delete the test from frozen_html.rs and rely on the form's own sample-payload tests.

options.name: Record an exception
options.detail: Record the test as a documented exception to the one-line rule.
